claim: Round/Abs/Min/Max/Floor/Ceiling run as built-in numeric functions (#547)

expected.notes: `Round`, `Abs`, `Min`, `Max`, `Floor` and `Ceiling` were not declared anywhere, so every call was `DMFUN001 Call to unknown function`. `FunctionAnalysis.Find` resolves only `Domain.Functions`, and the lowering of a call only binds a declared function's parameters — there was no builtin table and no lowering arm. A bank fee (`Balance * 0.015`) therefore could not be rounded to cents: no legal money amount could be produced.
